mono-20201.d: Every cat owner knows the look. The last word on the matter, and the cat has its paw on the full stop.
mono-20201.t: A cat lies along the top of a huge hand-cut NO, tail hanging down beside the N, staring straight out with a deadpan, half-lidded look, one front paw pressed on the full stop at the end of the line, about to push it off
